title: Multilingual campaign page
brief: Publish the FreshSip campaign landing page in English and French for Canadian shoppers.
clarifications: What happens when a translation is missing: fall back or block publishing?

requirements.title: Complete translations
criteria: Publishing is blocked when any required key is missing for a required locale.
Legal copy must come from approved strings, never machine translation.

requirements.title: Layout robustness
criteria: No text is clipped or overflows at 320 px width in any locale.
fr-CA strings 30% longer than English render without truncating calls to action.

test_plan: Visual overflow check at 320/768/1280 px per locale
Fallback behaviour when a non-required locale is missing
implementation_note: Template and preview only. These are not implemented end to end in this prototype.
